external_deps: Docker or Podman for the local instance

review.tagline: Rust graph database with native vector and BM25 search
review.summary: HelixDB is a Rust database that combines a labeled property graph, approximate nearest-neighbor vector search and BM25 full-text search in one transactional engine. A CLI starts a local instance in Docker or Podman on port 6969 (in-memory by default, --disk to persist) or the engine runs embedded, and Rust, TypeScript, Python and Go SDKs send the same JSON queries to POST /v2/query.
review.audience: developers wanting graph plus vector retrieval in one store
strengths: Graph traversal, vector ANN and BM25 in one transactional engine
Vector search prefiltered by graph traversal
SDKs for Rust, TypeScript, Python and Go sending the same JSON query
Embedded mode runs inside your process without a server
weaknesses: Local data is in-memory unless started with --disk
Python and Go SDKs are 0.x while Rust and TypeScript are 3.x
Cypher support only in source builds
Install is a curl piped to bash script
needs: Needs Docker or Podman for the local instance
Models: any embedding model; stores precomputed vectors
